The alternate view contrasts this stability, showcasing a rapid, volatile disintegration. statement: This sketch visualizes the dramatic disintegration of crystalline structures in the style of traditional Edo woodblock prints. Instead of slow growth, it depicts sudden, violent fragmentation where crystals shatter into bursts of luminous particles. The work captures the contrast between ordered formation and chaotic dissolution through a palette of muted grays and pale pinks that evoke both mineral complexity and ethereal light. Each crystal grows gradually before exploding into dozens of fragments that disperse with physics-based motion, creating an effect that feels both organic and otherworldly.
